title: ERP Implementation Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 Subham Group of Industries is a rice milling group based in India, focused on delivering high\-quality rice products to domestic and international markets. The organization operates modern milling facilities and emphasizes efficiency, product consistency, and food safety. Subham Group of Industries values innovation in its production processes and is exploring digital transformation to strengthen operations. The company offers opportunities for emerging professionals to contribute to process improvements and technology adoption within a growing agribusiness environment.
   

**Role Description** 
 The ERP Implementation Intern will support the rollout and optimization of the organization’s ERP system as part of ongoing digital transformation efforts. This internship role is hybrid, with primary work based in Mumbai and flexibility for some work\-from\-home tasks. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting in requirements gathering, documenting business processes, supporting data migration, and helping test ERP modules for finance, operations, and customer service. The intern will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to monitor system performance, resolve basic user issues, and prepare training materials and user guides. The role also involves tracking implementation timelines, preparing status reports, and identifying areas for process improvement within the ERP framework.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to support ERP\-related decisions.
* Candidates should possess planning skills to assist in scheduling tasks, tracking milestones, and coordinating implementation activities.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills to work with cross\-functional teams and explain ERP processes clearly.
* Candidates should possess a basic understanding of finance to support ERP modules related to accounting, billing, and reporting.
* Candidates should possess customer service orientation to help address user queries and contribute to a positive ERP user experience.
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree in business, finance, information systems, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Familiarity with ERP concepts, spreadsheets, and basic data management tools is beneficial.
* Ability to work in a hybrid environment, manage time effectively, and adapt to changing business needs.

title: Process Improvement Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 Bring your expertise to a high\-visibility internal consulting team where you can shape target\-state processes, strengthen controls, and grow your impact across the business.
   

  

 As a Process Improvement Associate in the Performance Consulting – Process Intelligence team within Consumer and Community Banking, you will partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to analyze end\-to\-end processes and design ideal target\-state workflows. You will apply process improvement skills, critical thinking, and data\-driven diagnostics to identify root causes and generate practical solutions that improve efficiency and reduce risk. You will help advance intelligent automation and robotic process automation opportunities, including the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities, while communicating recommendations in an executive\-ready way.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and documentation to synthesize findings, shape recommendations, and influence senior stakeholders through clear storytelling
* Leverage firm\-approved artificial intelligence tools and developer copilots to enhance delivery approaches and continuously improve the team's process intelligence offerings
* Partner with project team members to interview stakeholders, analyze process documentation, and gather data to identify improvement opportunities
* Lead one or more projects by demonstrating leadership through influence and strengthening team and organizational culture
* Collaborate with the team to build hypothesis sets, analyses, and roadmaps while identifying roadblocks, escalating risks, and proposing solutions
* Analyze key business processes to identify opportunities for improvement and automation, using data analytics to provide ongoing insight
* Contribute to the testing and deployment of process tools and technologies to ensure alignment with operational standards and objectives
* Facilitate working sessions to align stakeholders on current\-state pain points, target\-state design decisions, and ownership for follow\-through
* Quantify operational, risk, and financial impact opportunities to support prioritization and clarify expected benefits
* Embed risk and control considerations into target\-state process designs to support well\-controlled execution and change readiness
* Support change adoption by preparing clear materials and reinforcing new ways of working with partner teams


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Use process mapping tools (for example, Microsoft Visio, Signavio, or Business Process Model and Notation) to document and analyze workflows
* Apply data analytics to interpret models and diagrams and communicate data requirements and assets clearly
* Communicate complex ideas, concepts, or data through effective storytelling for diverse audiences
* Collaborate with diverse teams with varied experiences, skills, and backgrounds
* Operate artificial intelligence tools responsibly, including exposure to data and knowledge work, learning from experience, reasoning and planning, and safe human–artificial intelligence interaction
* Demonstrate strong problem\-solving, client management, and executive\-level communication skills
* Own tasks and manage most elements of an end\-to\-end workstream with appropriate follow\-up and accountability
* Translate ambiguous problems into structured hypotheses, clear workplans, and actionable outputs
* Produce concise, executive\-ready materials that connect findings to recommendations and decisions
* Practice sound risk awareness when proposing process changes that affect controls, roles, or handoffs
* Adapt quickly across multiple initiatives while maintaining quality and attention to detail


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Create senior\-ready presentations and narratives in written and verbal formats
* Apply systems thinking to analyze complex processes and identify optimization and integration opportunities
* Align process improvements to customer service principles to enhance satisfaction and outcomes
* Foster cross\-functional collaboration to identify and implement improvement opportunities across teams
* Use agile methodologies to iteratively develop and refine process improvements with flexibility and responsiveness to change
* Bring: "Preferred experience supporting more than one CCB Operations Function/Line of Business"
* Demonstrate: “Developing experience using AI\-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.”


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Operations teams develop and manage innovative, secure service solutions to meet clients' needs globally. Developing and using the latest technology, teams work to deliver industry\-leading capabilities to our clients and customers, making it easy and convenient to do business with the firm. Teams also drive growth by refining technology\-driven customer and client experiences that put users first, providing an unparalleled experience.

title: Senior Analyst, Drug Information & Risk Management
description:
**About Apotex Inc.**
 Apotex is a Canadian\-based global health company. We improve everyday access to affordable, innovative medicines and health products for millions of people worldwide, with a broad portfolio of generic, biosimilar, innovative branded pharmaceuticals and consumer health products. Headquartered in Toronto, with regional offices globally, including in the United States, Mexico and India, we are the largest Canadian\-based pharmaceutical company and a health partner of choice for the Americas for pharmaceutical licensing and product acquisitions.
   

  

 For more information visit: www.apotex.com .
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Part of multi\-disciplined team of healthcare professionals who support Apotex products (domestic and international) by coordination of the development of medical documents such as Risk Management \& Risk Evaluation Mitigation Plans, informing internal and external customers of the safe and effective use of drugs manufactured and marketed by Apotex Inc. and their affiliates/distributors worldwide by providing professional, unbiased, clinically relevant and timely medical information.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Provides verbal and written responses to medical inquiries from healthcare professionals, sales representatives and other internal customers on Apotex products.
* Evaluates, analyzes and responds to medical inquiries in an accurate, balanced and timely manner.
* Coordinates the preparation/updating of Risk Management \& Risk Evaluation Mitigation Plans globally including input into the medical sections of them using relevant regional templates.
* Demonstrates technical and scientific skills in the research and interpretation of medical information.
* Creates and peer reviews new and revised medical information documents (e.g. response documents, recall QAs, bulletins, etc.)
* Participates in departmental and cross\-functional business teams by supporting team initiatives and contributing directly or indirectly to team goals/projects based on priority to the business. Ensures compliance with all SOPs pertaining to adverse event and quality complaint reporting.
* Maintains awareness of current therapeutics and industry\-based medical information regulations.
* Provides on\-call coverage as per schedule
* Assists in the preparation of reports
* Updates/maintains product databases/files as required.
* Works as a member of a team to achieve all outcomes. Performs all work in accordance with all established regulatory and compliance and safety requirements.
* Perform all other duties and special projects and after\-hour coverage of DISPedia unit as assigned.
* Works in a safe manner collaborating as a team member to achieve all outcomes.
* Demonstrate Behaviours that exhibit our organizational Values: Collaboration, Courage, Perseverance, and Passion.
* Ensure personal adherence with all compliance programs including the Global Business Ethics and Compliance Program, Global Quality policies and procedures, Safety and Environment policies, and HR policies.
* All other relevant duties as assigned.


**Job Requirements** 
  

  

* Education
+ Bachelor of Pharmacy.
+ Sc., or Diploma in Health/Science related discipline
+ Master of Pharmacy
+ Bachelor of Dental Surgery

* Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
+ Excellent oral/written communication skills.
+ Knowledge of Microsoft office software: Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.
+ Knowledge of Arisg Safety Database, MedDRA and Argus
+ Knowledge of Embase and MLM database
+ Knowledge of online literature searching and review.


  

  

* Experience
+ 1\-3 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance.


 At Apotex, we are committed to fostering a welcoming andaccessible work environment, where all everyone feels valued, respected, and supported to succeed.
   

  

 We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities as part of its recruitment process. If you are contacted to arrange for an interview or testing, please advise us if you require an accommodation.

title: Product Stewardship Specialist
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You On This Role**
 We are committed to delivering fast, accurate, and customer\-centric support that helps customers confidently navigate product safety, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 As a
 **Product Stewardship Specialist** 
 , you will play a critical role in ensuring the safe and compliant use of our products by addressing Environmental, Health \& Safety (EH\&S) and regulatory inquiries from customers and internal stakeholders. This position sits at the intersection of customer care, product stewardship, and regulatory compliance, requiring strong collaboration, analytical thinking, and effective communication. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer\-focused, and experienced in regulatory and compliance\-related topics. You will thrive in a dynamic, multinational environment by effectively managing priorities, analyzing data, tracking progress, and partnering with global teams to deliver timely and accurate solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer Environmental, Health \& Safety (EH\&S) and regulatory inquiries, providing timely and accurate responses while engaging subject matter experts when required.
* Manage and track customer inquiries through internal systems, ensuring proper documentation, timely follow\-up, and resolution of high\-priority requests.

title: Manager - L&D Content Development
description:
**Role Details:**




**Designation** 
 : Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources \| Department: L\&D
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director Talent Engagement and Development
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Lower Parel)
 



**Span:** 
 Central L\&D
 



**Experience:** 
 8 – 10 years
 



  





**Role Overview:**




 The Manager \- Content Development designs and builds the learning content used across BDO India. The role turns learning needs into structured, usable content for leadership, behavioural and AI programmes, spanning e\-learning, workshop material, learning resources and assessments. It owns the content design standard every Service Line Academy follows and helps academy experts turn what they know into well designed learning.
 



  





**Key accountabilities:**




**Instructional design:** 



* Turn a learning need into clear objectives, a design and a storyboard, using an established approach such as ADDIE or SAM, and Bloom's Taxonomy to pitch each objective at the right level.
* Design blended learning journeys for the leadership tracks alongside the Leadership and Behavioural Trainers.
* Work with subject matter experts, business leads and HR to draw out raw knowledge and break it into simple, bite sized learning components.



**Content production:** 



* Build e\-learning content: interactive modules, microlearning, video and job aids for self\-paced learning.
* Build workshop content: instructor led decks, facilitator guides, playbooks, participant workbooks and activity material for classroom and virtual sessions.
* Build supporting learning resources: flyers, learning snippets, ready reckoners and post programme reinforcer material that keep learning alive after the session.
* Package content for the learning platform in SCORM and test it before release.



**Assessments and feedback:** 



* Design polls, surveys, pulse checks and feedback forms that capture learner response and inform the next round of content.
* Write knowledge checks, scenario\-based simulations and practical assessments that measure whether learning has actually landed and maintain the question banks.



**Design standard and academy support:** 



* Own the organisation's content design standard and templates and review academy content against them on request.
* Coach academy subject matter experts on how to structure and design what they teach.
* Build the materials for the Internal Facilitation Certificate alongside the trainers.



**Content governance:** 



* Keep the central content library organised, with version control and a refresh date on every item.
* Make sure content built by vendors is owned by BDO India, and that content is accessible to every learner.



  





**Experience and qualifications:**



* 8\-10 years in instructional design or learning content development, with at least 3 years running projects end to end.
* Corporate or professional services experience preferred.
* Hands on skill with authoring tools such as Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise) or Adobe Captivate, video tools such as Camtasia or Vyond, and design tools such as Canva or the Adobe suite.
* Practical experience using AI Productivity Tools and Multimedia for text, video and voice is preferable.
* Working knowledge of SCORM and how content behaves on a learning platform.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree. An instructional design certification is an advantage.



  





**About BDO:**




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. title: Data Migration Intern – Google Workspace
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Experience:** 
 0–1 year / Freshers
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Internship
   

  

**Duration:** 
 2–3 months
   

  

**Stipend:** 
 Paid
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented
 **Data Migration Intern** 
 to support a company\-wide migration of employee email accounts and associated data from one Google Workspace environment to another.
   

  

 The intern will work closely with the People and IT teams to ensure employee data is migrated accurately, systematically and with minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 This is a project\-based role and will involve working with employee data, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and migration trackers.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

**Email \& Data Migration**
* Support migration of employee email accounts from the existing Google Workspace/domain to the new Google Workspace/domain.
* Assist with migration of relevant mailbox data, emails, contacts, calendars and other approved Google Workspace data.
* Follow defined migration processes and checklists for each employee/account.
* Ensure data is transferred accurately and completely as per the migration plan.
* Support account setup and configuration activities as required.


**Data Validation \& Quality Checks**
* Maintain a detailed migration tracker covering all employee accounts.
* Verify migrated emails and other data against the source account.
* Identify missing, incomplete or incorrectly migrated data and coordinate resolution.
* Conduct post\-migration checks to ensure employees can access their new accounts and required data.
* Maintain clear records of completed, pending and exception cases.


**Coordination**
* Coordinate with employees to schedule migration activities and resolve basic access\-related queries.
* Work closely with the IT/Google Workspace administrator during the migration.
* Escalate technical issues or exceptions that require administrator intervention.
* Support employee communication around migration timelines, access and required actions.


**Documentation**
* Maintain migration SOPs, checklists and trackers.
* Document recurring issues and their resolutions.
* Prepare daily/weekly migration status reports.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality while handling employee and business data.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Graduate/student pursuing a degree in Computer Applications, IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related field.
* Comfortable working with Google Workspace, particularly Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Calendar.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organisational and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working with large volumes of data.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow structured processes and checklists.
* Strong sense of confidentiality and responsibility when handling employee data.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Basic understanding of Google Workspace administration.
* Exposure to email or data migration projects.
* Familiarity with CSV files, data validation and spreadsheet\-based reconciliation.
* Basic troubleshooting skills.
* Experience working with Google Admin Console would be an advantage.


 Key Success Measures
   

  

**The Intern Will Be Expected To Contribute Towards**
* Accurate and timely migration of assigned employee accounts.
* Minimal data loss or migration errors.
* Complete and accurate migration tracking.
* Timely identification and escalation of exceptions.
* Successful post\-migration validation.
* Clear documentation of the migration process.


 What You Will Learn
   

  

* Hands\-on exposure to a real\-world Google Workspace migration.
* Understanding of email, cloud data and user account migration.
* Data validation, reconciliation and project tracking.
* Cross\-functional coordination with People and IT teams.
* Exposure to managing a company\-wide technology transition.


 Important
   

  

 This role will involve access to employee and business information.
 **Confidentiality, data security and adherence to approved migration processes will be mandatory.**

title: Senior Solutions Analyst
description:
**About Quantanite \& QiQ** 




 Quantanite is a BPO company that combines human agents with proprietary AI technology. QiQ (Quantanite iQ) is our flagship AI\-powered contact centre analytics platform built on cutting\-edge agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and large language models.
 



 QiQ functions as a virtual organization of specialized AI agents that analyze customer interactions, generate operational insights, and drive measurable business outcomes. The platform processes voice, email, and chat interactions through intelligent clusters (Operations, Quality, Voice of Customer) to surface KPI insights, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.
 



 We're looking for someone who has built agentic systems and can help design, architect, and deliver solutions for clients using this technology.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Senior Solutions Analyst, you'll work closely with the Solutions Architect to translate client needs into technical solutions built on agentic AI and knowledge graph architecture. You'll own the full discovery\-to\-delivery cycle for client implementations and feature development, and over time, you'll represent Solutions independently in client conversations and make real architectural decisions.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You'll design solutions that leverage agentic patterns, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and knowledge graphs to solve real contact centre problems. You'll also learn Quantanite's specific platform, clients, and domain so that you can eventually operate as a full Solutions Architect.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Client discovery and solutioning: Lead or co\-lead discovery calls with clients to understand their true operational problems, not just their stated requests. Propose solutions architected around agentic AI and knowledge graph patterns.
 



 ● BRD and HLD authorship: Own the creation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and High\-Level Design (HLD) documents that translate client needs into clear, actionable specifications for engineering. Contribute real architectural thinking, not just transcription.
 



 ● Architecture and design decisions: Make calls on solution shape: which problems need agentic systems vs. simpler approaches, how to layer knowledge graphs, when to build custom orchestration vs. use existing patterns. Own the trade\-offs (cost, speed, accuracy, complexity).

 We are seeking a
 **Business Program \& Operations Analyst – UAT \& Implementation** 
 to support a highly visible, enterprise\-wide refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation initiative being deployed across approximately 7,530 retail locations. This large\-scale program is transforming a traditionally manual temperature\-checking and logging process through sensor technology, automated data collection, temperature alerts, and work\-order automation.
   

  

 The program is designed to provide greater visibility into refrigeration equipment performance, identify potential equipment and temperature issues earlier, reduce product loss, support compliance requirements, improve preventive and corrective maintenance processes, and generate significant operational efficiencies and cost savings.
   

  

 In this role, you will help ensure the program is successfully implemented across the store network by supporting business requirements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process and SOP validation, training, operational readiness, implementation quality, and go\-live activities. You will work cross\-functionally with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and other program resources to ensure solutions meet business requirements and implementations remain on schedule without compromising quality.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst or program implementation experience, with hands\-on exposure to UAT, business process testing, requirements validation, training, and implementation readiness. Experience supporting retail, facilities, store operations, or large\-scale multi\-site implementations would be especially valuable.
   

  

**Click Apply Now To Join The Chamberlain Experience.**

* Support the implementation and deployment of a large\-scale refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation program across approximately 7,530 retail locations.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, define, document, clarify, and validate business and operational requirements.
* Ensure new processes, system functionality, and implementations align with established business requirements and operational needs.

* Help ensure installations and implementations are completed correctly and meet established business and quality standards.
* Support data validation activities to ensure information captured during implementation is accurate and complete.
* Track testing activities, implementation issues, dependencies, readiness items, and stakeholder deliverables through completion.
* Balance an aggressive implementation timeline with the need for high\-quality testing, validation, and execution.
* Support successful go\-live activities and the transition of new processes into ongoing business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, implementation effectiveness, operational consistency, and user adoption.

description:

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.

* Running the logistics and operations for a number of information security and privacy training programs, whilst supporting the team to ensure the training runs smoothly from start to finish and also maintaining database in required quality.
* Support CISO team in financial/service slide deck \& other reporting requirements
* Support raising requisition, receipting in oracle REQ and also maintaining database.
* Support coordination in Security Processes \& recharges recovery.
* Provide CISO with supplier onboarding support
* Undertake general administrative tasks such as minute taking at team and project meetings and supporting the wider Security team where needed.
* Collaborate with trainers to analyse the effectiveness of the session, and proactively offer suggestions for improvements, through participation.
* Communicating effectively and building relationships with key stakeholders for effective security and privacy awareness
* Provide proof reading and editorial support for all written material.
* Is responsible for driving reporting excellence across CISO
* Support security coordination activities like BCP, Third Party Oversight or any other governance requirements.
* Work closely with the Tech Resilience team as a DR Spoc for Enterprise Security and Privacy team to co\-ordinate the DR activities relates to Cloud DR Programme and projects

* Graduate in finance or commerce. (A Levels or equivalent qualification).

 Consultation and/or assistance with external reviews for our various teams.

 Proven track record of innovation, initiative, creativity, and implementation
 



 Proven abilities to embrace, drive and enable change management
 



 Technical and working knowledge with the following creative software applications:
 



 Avid Media Composer
 



 Adobe Premiere
 



 Colorfront (Transkoder/OSD/ExD)
 



 Black Magic Davinci Resolve
 



 ProTools
 



 Filmlight (Baselight/Daylight)
 



 Pix
 



 Experience with Crestron and Q\-Sys control systems is a plus.
 



 Familiarity with audio, video, and data communications protocols.
 



 Strong communication skills with proven ability to socialize, explain and promote new and complex technology, tools, and workflows.
 



 Ability to respond after hours for important, timely, and urgent matters.
 



 Ability to prioritize and juggle multiple projects at once.
 



 Team player who thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 Should possess strong organizational skills and great attention to detail.
 



 Values working in a diverse, inclusive, and international environment and are excited by the opportunity to partner with people whose backgrounds, experiences and perspectives may differ from yours.
 



 Fluent and/or business proficiency in English
 



 Passionate about our culture and values in the workplace.

title: Institutional Equity Division - Senior Manager, EMEA Equity Documentation Negotiator (Mumbai)
description:
EMEA Equity Documentation( ISDA) , Institutional Equity Division
   

  

 This role is in Mumbai and requires working with the EMEA Equity Documentation Group based in London. The role will require a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active, and self\-motivated person to assist the team in its day\-to\-day activities.
   

  

 The current opening is for a professional within the EMEA team, based in Mumbai, with responsibility for documentation aspects of OTC derivative transactions, prime brokerage, cash and stock\-lending transactions in the EMEA region.
   

  

**Global Capital Markets:** 
 In the Global Capital Markets division, we offer Global expertise in market analysis and in advisory and capital\-raising services for corporations, institutions, and governments
   

  

 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales \& Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Manage the team of lawyers on the ground, co\-ordinate with stakeholder on team dynamics, work management and allocations. Grooming/ training of team
* Draft, negotiate and execute (including amendments to) master derivatives agreements, including but not limited to ISDA, VM CSA, IM CSA, equity swaps /options and prime brokerage related documentation.
* Review and analyze constitutional documents of the client, to establish their capacity and authority capabilities for entering derivative transactions with Morgan Stanley.
* Review and analyze capacity and authority legal opinion from external counsel and highlight issues to Risk and Legal for approvals where applicable.
* Work closely with MS internal stakeholders, to obtain approvals on deviated terms identified in negotiable agreements, with clear implication on deviated terms to enable internal stakeholders to make informed decisions.
* Handle business unit’s queries on the terms of documentation ISD handles.
* Participate in globally or locally led projects related to documentation requirements.
* Undertake tasks directly related to the coordination and lifecycle management of the clients’ agreements and act as the primary point of contact for the clients for all tasks originating from the Asia Pacific region.
* Responsible for administering and facilitating the agreement execution process; maintain and update clients’ contract database/systems; attend to day\-to\-day coordination among internal procurement and legal teams with respect to such contracts; and perform due diligence to ensure contract terms and conditions as well as information of the parties is reflected in the client’s contract database/systems.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Law graduate with relevant 8\-11 years of experience in financing/derivatives is preferred. Legal qualification is advantageous.
* Experience in team management will be preferred.
* In\-house documentation negotiation experience or paralegal experience in corporate law firm is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Prepared to speak to clients (internal and external) at all times.
* Proficiency in English is a must. Good team player with potential to lead a team.
* Solid quantitative skills and strong interest in business, economics, and law.
* Willingness and ability to provide quality service to the Firm's clients and to promote and enhance the Firm franchise.
* Willingness to work in dynamic environment and the ability to excel under pressure.
* Proficiency and interest in technology and systems development.
* Organized, pro\-active, ability to multi\-task and work efficiently, detail\-oriented, and self\-sufficient.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Electrical Engineering
description:
**Electrical Engineering Expert (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to make AI smarter — and we need electrical engineers to help get there. As an Electrical Engineering AI Trainer, you'll stress\-test cutting\-edge language models against real, advanced engineering problems, expose their weaknesses, and help build the next generation of technically rigorous AI.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role — work on your schedule, from anywhere.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Craft advanced electrical engineering problems spanning circuit analysis, power systems, signal processing, electromagnetics, embedded systems, and control theory to push AI models to their limits
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions that serve as benchmarks for AI learning and evaluation
* Audit AI Outputs — Review and assess AI\-generated code, circuit diagrams, and mathematical proofs for technical accuracy, safety, and compliance with engineering standards (IEEE, NEC, etc.)
* Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify logical gaps and flawed reasoning in AI responses, then provide structured feedback to improve model performance on complex engineering tasks


**Who You Are**
* Currently pursuing or have completed a Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a closely related field
* Strong foundational expertise in one or more core domains — VLSI, control systems, telecommunications, power electronics, or signal processing
* Able to explain highly technical concepts clearly and precisely in writing
* Meticulous with mathematical equations, circuit logic, and technical documentation
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously
* No prior AI experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or AI evaluation workflows
* Familiarity with simulation tools (SPICE, MATLAB, etc.)
* Background in academic or industry research


**Why Join Us**
* Work on genuinely cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research teams
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and workload
* Freelance autonomy with the backing of a professional, global team
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced large language models are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Senior Associate
description:
**About Us** 




 The Spine Foundation is a non\-profit organization dedicated to delivering free, high\-quality spine care to underprivileged communities in rural India. Founded over 25 years ago by a team of committed spine surgeons, the foundation focuses on alleviating chronic pain, limited mobility, and loss of livelihood caused by spinal disorders. Through specialized camps and outreach programs, it provides essential diagnostics, surgeries, and rehabilitation to individuals who otherwise could not afford such care. A volunteer network of leading Indian spine surgeons ensures patients receive expert treatment and a real chance to regain independence. In addition to clinical services, the foundation actively promotes spinal health awareness and preventive education to enable long\-term community well\-being.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Spine Foundation is looking for a highly committed and mature professional to work closely with Dr. Shekar Bhojraj and shadow him across his institutional, clinical, field, donor, partner and stakeholder engagements.
 



 This is a senior coordination and documentation role designed to support continuity, capture institutional knowledge, strengthen follow\-up systems and enable more structured planning around Dr. Bhojraj’s work. The role is not a conventional Executive Assistant or Research Associate position. It requires someone who can understand the purpose of TSF’s work, observe closely, document meaningfully, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and support the translation of conversations into clear action points.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Shadowing Dr. Bhojraj’s Work** 




 Accompany or closely support Dr. Bhojraj across meetings, visits, discussions, field engagements, hospital and doctor interactions, partner meetings and other institutional activities. The person will be expected to understand the context, capture key points and ensure that important conversations are not lost.
 



**2\. Documentation of Conversations and Engagements** 




 Prepare concise and useful notes from meetings, field visits, calls and stakeholder interactions. This will include recording key decisions, commitments, follow\-up points, relationship context and any strategic issues that require attention.
 



**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 




 Liaise regularly with doctors, hospitals, field teams, partners, donors, advisors, board members, consultants and other stakeholders connected with TSF’s work. The person should be able to communicate professionally, follow up respectfully and ensure that coordination does not remain dependent only on Dr. Bhojraj.
 



**4\. Planning, Scheduling and Follow\-up** 




 Support planning and scheduling of Dr. Bhojraj’s meetings, visits and travel\-linked engagements. This includes coordinating with relevant people, preparing briefs before meetings, ensuring that background information is available, and tracking follow\-up after each engagement.
 



**5\. Institutional Memory and Continuity** 




 Help TSF build stronger institutional memory around Dr. Bhojraj’s relationships, decisions, field insights and strategic directions. The person should be able to organise information in a way that helps the wider team, leadership and advisors take work forward with clarity.
 



**6\. Support to Strategic and Operational Priorities** 




 Work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and other identified team members or consultants to support planning around institutional priorities, donor conversations, centre\-level engagements, doctor networks, camps, outreach visits and emerging opportunities.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should have:
 



 • A Master’s degree in social work, public health, development studies, management, hospital administration, rural development or a related field.
 



 • 5\-8 years of relevant experience, preferably with exposure to both grassroots work and management\-level coordination.
 



 • Prior experience working closely with senior leadership, founders, trustees, doctors, programme heads or institutional leaders.
 



 • Strong understanding of community\-based work, health systems, rural development or social sector institutions.
 



 • Excellent documentation, note\-taking and synthesis skills.
 



 • Ability to capture not just minutes of meetings, but the larger context, relationships, concerns and follow\-up actions.
 



 • Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Ability to manage sensitive conversations with maturity and discretion.
 



 • Comfort with travel and accompanying leadership for field visits, stakeholder meetings and institutional engagements.
 



 • Good written and spoken communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of Marathi or other regional languages will be an added advantage.
 



 • High level of integrity, patience, humility and commitment to the cause of equitable spine care.
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 The person must be deeply aligned with TSF’s mission and should be comfortable working in a role that requires observation, listening, coordination and quiet leadership. They should be proactive without being intrusive, organised without being bureaucratic, and sensitive to the clinical, human and institutional dimensions of Dr. Bhojraj’s work.
 



 This role is suitable for someone who is passionate about public health and social impact, and who sees value in helping an institution strengthen continuity around a founder’s vision, relationships and way of working.
 



 Reporting and Working Relationship
 



 The person will work closely with Dr. Bhojraj and coordinate with identified members of the TSF team, doctors, external advisors and consultants as required. The role will require regular interaction with internal and external stakeholders and will involve both office\-based and travel\-linked responsibilities.
 



 Expected Outcome of the Role
 


* Over time, the role should help TSF ensure that Dr. Bhojraj’s work, relationships, insights and decisions are better captured, followed through and institutionalized. The position is intended to strengthen continuity, coordination and leadership support as TSF prepares for its next phase of growth and sustainability.



  





**Salary/Compensation** 




 Will commensurate based on the experience
 



  





**Additional Information:** 
 This role requires frequent travel, field visits, and close accompaniment of senior leadership, often involving long and unpredictable working hours. Considering these operational requirements, preference may be given to male candidates.

 Experience of DevOps tools and promote automation.

description:

 –
 **GRC Technology – Oracle GRC \- Senior**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for people with expertise in
 **Oracle GRC Senior Consultant** 
 to join our
 **EY\-GDS GRC Technology Team** 
 . This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholder.
* Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
* Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and forms recommendations for system and technical components based on understanding of business requirements, reviewing and supporting with process modelling and improvement.
* Contributes to the design and review of test cases to ensure tests adequately meet the requirements and coordinates with infrastructure and operations teams to resolve system issues, contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project.
* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
* Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems .


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 3 to 7 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
* 
+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role\-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre\-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power\-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance) \& Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Associate Consultant - Business Consulting Risk - TMT - CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Mumbai
description:
Requisition Id: 1745550
   

  

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world.  : Associate Consultant\-TMT\-Business Consulting Risk\-CNS \- Risk \- Process \& Controls \- Mumbai
   

  

**TMT :**
 Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media \& Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
   

  

 We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise\-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M\&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.
   

  

**CNS \- Risk \- Process \& Controls :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Strong understanding of digital media business models and risk\-related process and control frameworks. Proficient in using MS Office tools to analyze, organize, and present business and risk data effectively. Ability to support process and controls assessments, identifying gaps and documenting control weaknesses. Exposure to internal audit concepts with the capability to contribute to audit planning, testing, and reporting activities. Working knowledge of PowerBI for data visualization and preparation of concise, insight\-driven management outputs.


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor of Commerce
* Bachelor of Business Administration
* Certificate in Digital Marketing
* Certification in Data Analytics


**Experience**
* Data Analysis (2\+ years)
* Business Analysis (3\+ years)
* Technical Support (2\+ years)
* Digital Marketing (2\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
   

  

 EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

description:

Through our content writing and design services, we convert complex scientific ideas into engaging content and visuals tailored to different audiences.
 



  





 We are seeking writers to develop high\-quality academic multimedia content. The role involves distilling technical source material into engaging narratives and creating storyboards for outputs such as graphical abstracts, infographics, and videos.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




  




* Apply critical thinking and analytical skills to interpret published manuscripts and extract key insights, while ensuring that all content is scientifically accurate.
* Conceptualizing scientific concepts and heavy data into visual representations.
* Develop detailed storyboards with content, graphic guidance, and graphic references for designers.
* Creating scripts for video narrations.
* Creating articles, summaries, social media posts, and other content, which may include desk research to supplement content, sourcing peer\-reviewed scientific articles and citing references correctly.



  





**Qualifications and Prerequisites** 




  




* Master's and above in Physics, Chemistry or Medicine.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze manuscripts and synthesize complex information.
* Strong command of academic writing, grammar, and communication.
* Proficiency in conducting desk research and referencing scientific literature.
* Excellent responsiveness, reliability, and communication skills.



  





**Essential Skills** 



* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Creative mindset for visual storytelling in academic contexts.
* Professionalism in team interactions and feedback incorporation (as and when needed).

title: Process Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: Business Analyst**
 The Business Analyst works in close co\-ordination with all business owners and IT team members to analyze, design, document and implement solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Requirements Gathering \& Analysis
+ Significant experience with software development\-lifecycle and web technologies
+ Elicit, analyze, and document business and software requirements (BRD, SRS).
+ Translate business needs into functional and non\-functional requirements for developers.
+ Able to create proper functional requirements and detail specifications.
